page_title: Remove Background from Image for Free – remove.bg

sources.entry: 1. Remove.bg - Remove backgrounds from photos using AI.

summary.name: remove.bg
summary.one_liner: remove.bg is an AI-powered web and mobile tool that automatically removes image backgrounds and can generate new custom backdrops.
use_cases: Make white-background product or car listing photos
Create transparent PNG logos and graphics
Batch remove backgrounds from many images
Erase backgrounds on a phone while on the go
summary.what_it_does: The page describes remove.bg as an automatic background remover that isolates a subject from an image in about five seconds with one click. It offers an AI background generator that creates custom backdrops from no prompt. Users can set backgrounds to white or export transparent PNGs. Bulk editing is described as processing up to 500 images per minute. Integrations with Figma, Photoshop and Zapier are mentioned, along with a mobile app.
notable: Bulk editing up to 500 images per minute
AI background generator that needs no prompt
Integrations with Figma, Photoshop and Zapier
Mobile app for removing backgrounds on the go
caveats: Page mentions a Black Friday offer of 50% off selected yearly plans, implying paid yearly plans exist but pricing details are not on the page
Mobile app platforms (iOS/Android) are not named explicitly on the page
